flags.note: Extended — 90% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -5% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The company attempts to maintain double-digit growth in e-commerce year-on-year if possible.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "It would not be fair to put a number to it, but the attempt shall be to maintain a double-digit growth if possible." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 9.17% earnings growth vs 14% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 1.07 pp

opportunities.point: A services tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management expects the positive trend in feedstock inflows and financial outlook for the Mahindra joint venture to strengthen and continue.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "And we expect this trend to strengthen and continue, driving towards a healthy financial outlook for this company." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: MSTC will conduct the 15th round of Commercial Coal Block Auctions containing 17 mines.
For FY26, e-commerce earnings were driven by auctions of 10 coal mine blocks, over 200 major mineral blocks, scrap including plant sales, and coal linkage auctions.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "10 coal mine blocks, over 200 major mineral blocks, significantly higher scrap including quite a few plant sales, as well as coal linkage auctions, the order for which MSTC obtained from Coal India Limited through competitive bidding." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The TReDS platform is expected to be operationalized sometime during FY27, subject to regulatory approvals.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "This project is also at an advanced stage and subject to regulatory approvals being obtained, we should be able to operationalize this sometime during this FY27." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: The company's internal target is to obtain RBI approval for the TReDS platform and operationalize it within FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, our internal target is hopefully FY27, within FY27." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: MSTC Travel Portal for B2B is ready and currently being upgraded for future B2C operation.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "MSTC Travel Portal for B2B is ready and currently being upgraded for Future B2C operation." (concall ppt - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew 21% vs profit 14% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: Management highlighted global macroeconomic uncertainty as a challenge during the year.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So despite a considerable amount of global macroeconomic uncertainty, it's my pleasure to be able to report that MSTC has been able to end the year with good numbers." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun) are still in the cycle.
